s: Based on our Porrima™ PAM4 DSP platform, the new Alcor platform includes our PAM4 DSP technology, linear TIA and driver to provide even higher levels of integration and lower power for high-performance hyperscale data center, cloud computing and emerging AI applications.

Polaris Gen2 builds on the innovation of our field-proven Polaris Gen1 PAM4 platform, providing even higher levels of integration and lower power for high-performance hyperscale data center, cloud computing and emerging AI applications. Our products are designed into systems sold by OEMs, including Tier-1 OEMs in the telecom and networking system markets worldwide.
